fuel_consumption.source_quote: Excluding the impact of the anticipated AirTran acquisition, the Company expects to consume approximately 1.5 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2011.

instrument_type_details.notes: Mixture of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), and fixed-price swap agreements. Crude oil, heating oil, and unleaded gasoline-based derivatives used.

warnings: Net fair value of $207M includes gross derivative net asset of $142M plus $60M cash collateral held from counterparty minus $125M cash collateral posted to counterparty. Consumption estimates exclude anticipated AirTran acquisition.

2011 gallons figure from Note 10 forward table (778M gallons); 2012-2014 percentage figures from Item 7 MD&A narrative (approximately 60%, 50%, 45%). 2011 percentage coverage stated differently as tiered crude-oil price table in MD&A.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel and oil expense table: average cost $3,620 million, average cost per gallon $2.51 (Item 1, 2011 10-K filing)
